entries.label: Armored Lost/Borg · NECA Ultimate2020
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Ultimate Armored Lost/Borg, item51585, release September2020, licensed Predator2character toy masked-head accessory
entries.prompt:
Correct ONLY the global horizontal proportions of the isolated blue mask in reference1, faithfully matching the upper-right masked-head accessory of the official NECA catalogue in reference2. Independent source-view inspection confirms the original rigid shell is approximately166px wide by151px high (ratio1.10) after excluding dreadlocks, while reference1 is1079px wide by1069px high (ratio1.009). The crown-to-eyes-to-muzzle relative vertical levels are already good; the mask only needs approximately8–9percent MORE HORIZONTAL BREADTH coherently across the whole hard sculpt.
Keep all relative feature y levels and the same near-frontal slight-down source camera. Make the complete visible width/height approximately1.08–1.11. Do not change perspective, flare only the cheeks, raise the crown, elongate the central crest or muzzle, or invent a new symmetrical face. Center the entire corrected mask with about10percent empty margins along its longest axis; a slightly smaller overall occupancy is fine to keep every existing tip safely inside the frame. One complete native mask only, not a layout.
Preserve every actual dark navy/blue-violet sculpted plate and its grey/blue rubbed edges, the real central raised axial/triangular crown detail, short swept upper side plates, curled cheek housings and existing round ports, short central mechanical snout and lower recesses. EXACTLY the same two narrow red solid/opaque eye lenses, not new transparent eye holes. Keep the existing relief subdued; no new runes, symbols, horns, fangs, vents, pipes or invented microgeometry. The main green bare-headed figure in reference2 is NOT the subject. All wearer anatomy, dreadlocks/gold bands, neck, body, armour, cannon, sword and other catalogue accessories must remain absent. No unseen back/interior or profile reconstruction.
Maintain the current neutral catalogue-style lighting, painted blue-dark metal and restrained weathering for source-view A; no new colorway, stronger chrome, dramatic colored light or extra damage. Genuine transparent exterior alpha, no floor, stand, cast-shadow plane, caption, border, checkerboard, labels or text. This remains the photographed2020 licensed toy masked-head accessory, not an assertion that the unmasked film character wore this mask. Only fix the measured proportion error, preserving the source identity and all correct existing features.
entries.camera: Nearly frontal, slight downward source view; not physically calibrated.
limitations: Whole blue rigid masked-head accessory in1040x1300official catalogue; microgeometry and exact accessory projection limited by mask-area pixels.
Lost/Borg is unmasked in the cited film; the licensed2020toy accessory is a documented adaptation, not a filmed-prop certification.
A2 is a few percent broader than the reviewer's approximate source bounds; mask-area pixel resolution limits precision.
Fine relief and tiny ports are interpreted from a small source head; no exact 3D mesh, hidden rear or original-film mask certification.

notes: Main figure is unmasked and excluded; only the detached blue masked accessory is used.
Whole mechanical crown, paired opaque red lenses and short mechanical lower face retained.
No wearer anatomy or dreadlocks retained; B changes restrained materials/light only.

attempts.prompt:
Create ONE isolated rigid mask A from the actual photographed licensed toy edition: NECA Ultimate Armored Lost/Borg, item51585, release September2020, licensed Predator2character toy masked-head accessory. Reference1 controls the visible source camera, tilt, sculpture, asymmetries, proportions, paint palette and wear. Other references if present only corroborate this same edition, not another view to merge. Do not substitute a PHG interpretation, another edition or a generic Predator mask.

Use ONLY THE BLUE/DARK MASKED-HEAD ACCESSORY AT UPPER RIGHT of the white catalogue. The MAIN FIGURE is BARE-HEADED and not the mask. Keep the accessory's actual almost-frontal slight-down source camera and BROAD COMPACT proportions: the real hard-shell mask is visibly wider than tall, approximately1.10–1.18width/height excluding dreadlocks, not a long narrow helmet. Preserve its entire dark navy/blue-violet painted metal with edge-rubbed grey/blue highlights, the actual ornate layered forehead crown with central raised triangular/axial piece and existing small mechanical relief, the short paired swept upper side projections/plates, the two narrow vivid red solid lenses, bulky curled cheek housings/true small round ports and its short angular central mechanical snout/grille with actual visible lower recesses. These are photographed hard sculpted toy features, not biological skull/mandibles; preserve their real shape and placement, no new horns, runes, tubes or fang geometry. Remove all black dreadlocks/gold bands and the head/neck behind them, body armor, sword and hands. Blue body armor below is NOT part of the mask. No masked-film-appearance claim: this is the real toy accessory edition.

Remove every wearer component: living skin/cranium, eyes or teeth behind the mask, biological mandibles, all dreadlocks and their bands, neck, collar, body/chest/shoulder armor, shoulder cannon, cables/hoses belonging to the wearer, hands, weapons, mannequin/stand, scene/catalogue background and any unrelated separate heads or accessories. Keep only the complete rigid mask sculpture. Preserve solid lens materials and real recessed vents; do not expose or invent a living mouth. No new hidden rear/interior geometry or new profile. No forced frontalization, symmetrization, stretching or rotation from the selected source camera. No invented runes, letters, extra horns, tusks, holes, vents, or paint.

For A follow the actual source paint and neutral catalogue lighting where provided; do not create a new colourway. Preserve real sculpted relief and weathered finish, but do not add fictional microdetail to fake source resolution. One whole mask only, genuine transparent alpha, no floor, support, cast-shadow plane, labels/text/grid or duplicate. Request1254x1254square if supported; mask78–80percent of largest canvas axis with8–12percent clear margins all sides and no clipped edge. This is a documented photographed edition study, not canonical film-prop or human-art certification.
